name: Skills page and agent Skills tab render the seeded L02 skills
description: Read-only L02 check against the seed: /skills lists the seeded skills and opens one in the side-pane preview, then the Config tab with the '<name>.md' body header; /agents shows the Test Quality agent with its skill-count chip; Security Reviewer's Skills tab shows the design's '3 of 6 enabled'. Every find … click is preceded by a wait --text for its target (flows-contract authoring rules). The body editor gets a 40-line draft that is never saved: the textarea must be as tall and wide as its content (no internal scroll) while its frame scrolls. No model call, no writes.

the body editor shows the <name>.md header

cmd: (() => { const t = [...document.querySelectorAll('textarea')].find((x) => x.getAttribute('aria-label') === 'Skill body'); const lines = Array.from({ length: 40 }, (_, i) => (i === 19 ? 'x'.repeat(300) : 'line ' + (i + 1))); Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLTextAreaElement.prototype, 'value').set.call(t, lines.join(String.fromCharCode(10))); t.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); t.focus(); t.setSelectionRange(t.value.length, t.value.length); return 'SET ' + t.value.split(String.fromCharCode(10)).length; })()
steps.label: type a 40-line body draft (one 300-char line), caret at the end; never saved

cmd: (() => { const t = [...document.querySelectorAll('textarea')].find((x) => x.getAttribute('aria-label') === 'Skill body'); const f = t.parentElement; const n = t.value.split(String.fromCharCode(10)).length; const ok = n === 40 && t.scrollTop === 0 && t.scrollHeight <= t.clientHeight && t.scrollWidth <= t.clientWidth && f.scrollWidth > f.clientWidth; return ok ? 'BODY_EDITOR_OK' : 'BODY_EDITOR_BAD ' + JSON.stringify({ lines: n, scrollTop: t.scrollTop, scrollHeight: t.scrollHeight, clientHeight: t.clientHeight, scrollWidth: t.scrollWidth, clientWidth: t.clientWidth, frameScrollWidth: f.scrollWidth, frameClientWidth: f.clientWidth }); })()
